newsitem.title: UK: UK Tories cede control of key committee - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK Tories cede control of key committee - paper.

text.p: Britain's Conservative government has conceded control of the key House of Commons committee examining the budget, the Guardian reported on Thursday.
The Conservatives have agreed they should have only the same number of MPs on the committee as the opposition parties, said the paper.
The move comes as a surprise as ministers have been resisting opposition demands to surrender control of committees since they lost their majority in the lower house at a by-election last month.
The decision is also expected to increase the difficulties facing Prime Minister John Major in parliament if he decides to soldier on for his full term before he must call a general election in May.
Following the death of a Labour MP, the Conservatives now have exactly the same number of MPs as all the opposition parties combined.
